studies.title: Carved wooden maps
studies.caption: Kunit carves pieces of driftwood whose bumps and notches follow the coast of East Greenland, fjord by fjord.
studies.prompt: Intimate close study of a Greenlandic carvers hands holding a small irregular driftwood coastal map with a sequence of deep notches and projections, second narrow carved piece beside it, simple knife and weathered wood. East Greenland1884, practical skin sleeves, no inked modern map.
